title: Harbour & Hearth | Cafe and bakery on the quay
description: Fresh bread, good coffee, by the water. An independent cafe and bakery at Saltmarsh Quay, Essex.

hero.heading: Fresh bread, good coffee, by the water
hero.text: We bake every morning in an old net loft on the quay. Pull up a chair, watch the boats and have a second slice. Nobody's counting.

image.alt: Loaves of sourdough cooling on a wooden rack by a window overlooking the harbour

highlights.title: Baked here, daily
highlights.text: Sourdough, buns and cakes from our own ovens. When they're gone, they're gone.

highlights.title: Coffee worth the walk
highlights.text: Roasted down the coast by Tidewater Roasters. Made properly, every time.

highlights.title: Dogs and muddy boots welcome
highlights.text: Coming off the sea wall path? Come in as you are. There's water for the dog.

findUs.heading: Find us on the quay
findUs.text: We're the blue-doored loft at the end of Quay Street, next to the slipway. Free parking by the sailing club.
findUs.mapAlt: Map showing Harbour & Hearth at the end of Quay Street, by the slipway
